title: Current Hazard Premium of a Summit Reserve: Pay-Plan and Carry-Forward Bases
content:
At a review of the hazard insurance bills of a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, the current hazard premium is established on a pay-plan or carry-forward basis according to how many of the hazard bills of the review are paid or received. The hazard bills of the review are the hazard insurance bills on file for the reserve received within the twelve months before the review — no later than the review date and fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.

| Paid or received hazard bills of the review | Basis | Current hazard premium |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | Pay-plan basis | The sum of the billed amounts of those paid and received bills, because a policy billed in installments costs the sum of its installments |
| None | Carry-forward basis | The annual hazard premium already on file |
| Exactly one | — | Not set by this rule |

Withdrawn bills are neither paid nor received and are not added in.

**Hypothetical file.** Four hazard bills of the review — three paid at 310.00 and one received at 310.00 — give a current hazard premium of 1,240.00 on the pay-plan basis. A file whose only hazard bills of the review are withdrawn carries forward the annual hazard premium on file, say 1,150.00.
